# H9 — the owed EXPLAIN (ANALYZE): related-voices' three sweeps on production (2026-08-21)

Owner-directed run ("knock all of these out"). Shipped statement shape byte-faithful,
synthetic unit centroid, ef_search=400 transaction-local, read-only, rolled back.

## Verdict
- **Unfiltered sweep: HEALTHY under the H9 fix.** Index Scan on idx_embeddings_vector,
  300/300 rows delivered (only 63 filter-removed) — ef_search=400 fills the pool, 5.4s cold.
  At the old default 40 this leg starved by construction; the fix is doing its job.
- **Register sweeps (hymn, poetry): the planner SEQ SCANS — the GUC is inert there.**
  hymn: 28.5s cold, 1,106,503 rows filter-removed. poetry: 3.0s warm, 1,109,289 removed.
  No shipped index matches (register lives in metadata jsonb; every partial HNSW keys on
  source_type). **28.5s cold sits a hair under the route's maxDuration=30 — a cold-cache
  voices panel can TIME OUT on the register legs.**

## Filed follow-up (design decision, not a spot fix)
Either expression-partial HNSW indexes per register (pairs naturally with the authored
halfvec design, 121.draft) or drop the register sweeps in favor of a wider unfiltered pool
partitioned client-side — the trade is recall-per-register vs index count, and it belongs in
the halfvec design's measurement plan.
